title: The Penny Is Gone, But The Nickel Costs More
hook: America ended one money-losing coin while keeping an even costlier one.
closing: Ending the penny saves money, but the nickel leaves the same problem unresolved.
question: Should America stop making nickels?

segments.say: Making pennies lost 86 million dollars yearly. Ending production finally stops most of that waste.
The penny lasted 232 years before costs ended its run. No other discontinued coin survived nearly as long.
A nickel costs 13.78 cents to make. Killing the penny leaves an even larger loss in circulation.
